_metadata.description: Variant comparison and bounded batches. First-release contract; completion follows requirement-linked behavior and retained protocol evidence.

requirements.title: The workspace should compare and batch saved variants.
requirements.description: When multiple saved shot variants are selected, the workspace should provide side-by-side final-look comparison and bounded batch output while retaining per-variant receipts and budgets.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-BATCH-COMPARE protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.
